title: Operational Technologies (OT) Engineer
description:
Operational Technologies (OT) Engineer
Remote, United States | Up to 25% Travel (U.S. & Canada)
Advance Life Around the World with Dura-Line
Join Dura‑Line, an Orbia Connectivity Solutions business, where we create solutions that connect people and information across the globe. As a leading global manufacturer of conduit products and accessories, Dura‑Line creates the pathways that power connectivity across a wide range of markets worldwide. Quality, safety, and sustainability are at the core of everything we do, with environmentally responsible practices embedded throughout our manufacturing processes. Be part of our shared mission with Orbia to Advance Life Around the World.

About the Role
Dura-Line is seeking an experienced Operational Technologies (OT) Engineer to support and expand connectivity across our manufacturing operations.
This role serves as the bridge between manufacturing equipment, Operational Technology (OT) systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and accurate production data flows from the shop floor into the systems used by Engineering, Operations, and business leaders to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.
Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise and strong collaboration skills. You'll work closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT, and external equipment vendors to implement and support manufacturing connectivity solutions across multiple facilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving manufacturing data challenges, improving operational visibility, and supporting digital transformation initiatives in a multi-site manufacturing environment.
What You'll Do

• Design, implement, and support communications between manufacturing equipment, OT systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Ignition applications and integrations.

• Administer and support manufacturing historian platforms, including Canary Labs and similar technologies.

• Ensure manufacturing data is accurate, available, and reliable across OT systems and connected applications.

• Select and implement I/O and connectivity hardware to support manufacturing data acquisition requirements.

• Support integration and troubleshooting of PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.

• Develop and maintain OT standards, documentation, and best practices to improve system sustainability and scalability.

• Partner with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT teams, and equipment vendors to support manufacturing connectivity initiatives.

• Influence equipment selection and implementation decisions to ensure future data acquisition and connectivity requirements are met.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve manufacturing performance, operational visibility, and data integrity.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to plant maintenance and engineering teams.

• Support multiple manufacturing facilities through a combination of remote work and onsite project support.

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Automation, Controls Systems, Industrial Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience will also be considered.

• 3+ years of experience supporting Operational Technology (OT), industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or manufacturing connectivity solutions.

• Experience with Ignition SCADA configuration, administration, development, or support.

• Experience working with manufacturing historian platforms such as Canary, PI Historian, Wonderware Historian, or similar technologies.

• Knowledge of OPC communications , industrial networking, and manufacturing data acquisition systems.

• Working knowledge of PLC -controlled manufacturing equipment and industrial control systems.

title: Senior Specialist, Corporate Supplier Quality
description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International ?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You lead the compliance and capability related to global supplier quality policies and programs to ensure the highest quality and food safety of the materials we procure at the regional level. This is a leadership role with regular interaction with plant quality, food safety, procurement, R&D and other cross functional teams.
How you will contribute:
The Senior Specialist, Corporate Supplier Quality is responsible for leadership in the areas of supplier quality strategic direction, capability building of suppliers, and to collaborate with cross-functional partners such as procurement and RD to promote assurance of the execution of supplier quality policies and programs.
This position has regional responsibility which requires experience in prior quality roles such as Plant Quality, BU Quality, Audit, Food Safety or RD with experience engaging with suppliers, and understanding of Quality & Business Systems and the ability to influence stakeholders.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Lead the Material Monitoring Program (MMP) for the region.

• Co-Lead development of training materials and execute training for internal and external partners based on the capability building needs.

• Participate in risk assessment activity related to supplier spend areas, partnering with procurement and other cross-functional partners, following up on progress, and proactively assisting in issue resolution and elimination to assure that established company quality standards are consistently met with a key focus on Food Safety programs.

• Performs technical or audit prep visits and confirms gap closures to ensure higher (%) compliance rate against the supplier quality expectations (SQE).

• Work to continually improve performance against key supplier quality measures by proactively leading the program initiatives required to sustainably resolve identified Quality & Food Safety Risks (Quality notifications, Mondelez audit CAPAs).

• Continuously improve supplier quality related knowledge, skills and understanding of Internal and external personnel executing MDLZ requirements by conducting training programs and systematically disseminating written information covering standards, procedures, and policies to assure employees are equipped to meet required standards.

• Raise the bar on food safety and quality ensuring all suppliers, internal buyers and manufacturing facilities are meeting Mondelez expectations. Accountable for establishing / escalating proposals and recommendations in the event Supplier performance is in question; has the ability to recommend disapproval of suppliers who do not operate within our policies.

• Monitoring and reporting of key quality metrics and supporting Global Supplier Quality Initiatives.

• Support the SSMT coordinators on issue management and special situations.

What you will bring:
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

• Delivering risk-based supplier quality programs to support commercial outcomes within fast moving consumer goods environment.

• Influencing food safety strategy, providing value-chain observations and practical input that translates into significant business benefit with reduced Quality/Food Safety risks.

• Knowledge of food manufacturing processes, raw materials and Ingredient specifications.

• Collaborating to complete the agenda by working effectively across functions, geographies, and with internal and external partners.

• Relentless curiosity and a continuous improvement mentality.

• Building an internal network that allows for effective communication, influence and stakeholder engagement.

• Digital Savvy with analytical skills, SAP QM, and Power BI experience.

• Strength in CAPA Processes and Systems

Education / Certifications:

• B.S./M.S. in a related scientific discipline prefer

title: Commissions Systems Analyst
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated and adaptable Revenue Compensation Analyst to join our close-knit team. In this role, you will calculate compensation payouts, design compensation plans, test plans for accuracy, and implement requested compensation changes. While you will often work collaboratively within the team, you should also be comfortable handling tasks independently, such as performing detailed analyses and generating insights on compensation trends as needed by the business.

The ideal candidate is proficient in data analysis and excited to learn and adapt to the preferred software tools used by our business. We value a team-oriented mindset and are seeking someone eager to contribute to our collaborative culture, bringing a positive attitude and a willingness to learn and grow.

About the team

You will work directly with the Revenue Compensation Manager and the other Revenue Compensation Analyst in data management, compensation calculation, ad-hoc reporting for stakeholders, and any required communications to sales leaders or the field sales teams. The right candidate should be eager to work within a small team environment and be adaptable to frequent changing business needs.

What you get to do every day

• Meet and collaborate with various stakeholders and teams (Finance, Human Resources, and Revenue) to drive compensation plans and sales efficiency improvements

• Manage and administer all aspects of assigned commission plans from start to finish, including building out new plans and updating existing ones

• Improve and automate processes resulting in timely and accurate processing of commissions for multiple departments (Partnerships, Marketing, Sales, Sales Activation, and Customer Success)

• Conduct ad-hoc analysis of Revenue team performance and commission plan effectiveness

• Maintain quotas and measure attainment for Revenue team

• Manage ramp cycles for new hires and cascade quota coverage

• Collaborate with HR on performance management and any quota impacts from exits

What you bring to the role

• 3+ years of experience creating and/or managing sales or incentive compensation plans or equivalent sales analysis experience

• Ability to develop recommendations for stakeholders on best practices for quotas, accelerators, and compensation structures

• Data-driven approach to quota analysis and performance assessment

• Expertise in spreadsheets, logic, and data manipulation

• Strong understanding of data structures between systems

• Ability to troubleshoot and proactively resolve issues

• Strong communication skills and experience working directly with sales teams and organization leaders

• Highly organized and detail oriented

• Adaptable and able to handle frequently changing requirements

• Consulting, startup, and/or SaaS experience is a plus, but not required

• Salesforce experience is a plus, but not required

• CaptivateIQ or a similar commissions software experience is a plus, but not required

title: Payment Operator
description:
Join our team as a Payment Operator in the thriving iGaming industry! 🚀
This job opening is available within Southeast Asia only .
🧩Who we are
Ludicrum is redefining iGaming, blending creativity with technology to deliver world-class gaming experiences. From marketing and product development to customer support and financial reporting, our teams are changing the game. Our vision is to create ultra-intuitive and engaging platforms to fuel growth through strategic partnerships and market expansion.
With a dynamic and collaborative culture and fast career growth, our 250+ global team thrives!
🥜 In a nutshell
We're looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Payment Operator to join our Payments team!
In this role, you'll play a key part in ensuring smooth, accurate, and efficient payment operations, handling daily transactions, resolving payment-related issues, and supporting the team in delivering reliable payment processing services.
⏳ Shift Structure:
This position involves working a rotating three-shift schedule based on Central European Time (CET/CEST): 06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00, and 22:00-06:00 . You will work five days per week, including weekends and public holidays, as part of a 24/7 operation.
For candidates based in Southeast Asia, these shifts typically correspond to the following local working hours during Central European Time (CET):

• UTC+7 - 12:00-20:00 / 20:00-04:00 / 04:00-12:00

• UTC+8 - 13:00-21:00 / 21:00-05:00 / 05:00-13:00

• UTC+9 - 14:00-22:00 / 22:00-06:00 / 06:00-14:00

This means that, depending on the rotation, you will regularly work evening, overnight, and early morning shifts in your local time.
Please note that during European daylight saving time (CEST), all local shift times listed above will start and end one hour earlier.
🎯 The responsibilities & the impact YOU will have:

• Process incoming and outgoing payments accurately and efficiently, ensuring smooth daily operations.

• Verify transaction details and maintain accurate payment records across financial systems.

• Handle refunds, payment adjustments, and transaction discrepancies when needed.

• Identify and resolve payment-related issues, collaborating with team members to ensure timely solutions.

• Support Shift Leaders and Managers with daily operational tasks and payment-related activities.

• Share your knowledge and provide guidance to junior Payment Operators.

• Stay up to date with payment procedures, systems, and operational updates.

• Contribute ideas and feedback to improve workflows, efficiency, and overall team performance.

⚡ All you need is…

• A solid understanding of payment processing fundamentals and financial transactions.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle payment information with accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

• Good written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively with colleagues.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to resolve issues efficiently.

• A collaborative attitude, with the ability to work independently and support teammates when needed.

• Willingness to learn, adapt to new processes, and continuously develop your skills.

Nice to have

• Previous experience in payment processing, financial operations, or a similar role.

• Familiarity with communication tools such as Slack and Discord.

• Experience in customer service or other client-facing roles.

🌟 Why You’ll love working here:

• Flexible and Remote Working: Work from anywhere, supporting your work-life balance.

• Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation after 3 months, subject to manager approval, advance notice, and business needs.

• Equipment provided: We’ll set you up with a laptop, headphones, and mouse so you’re ready to work comfortably.

• Career Growth: We’re committed to your development, offering training and advancement opportunities.

• Performance Recognition: Earn raise

title: Medical Patient Representative
description:
About the Role
A US-based medical practice is seeking a Medical Patient Representative to join its patient access team. This is a front-line role that serves as many patients' first point of contact with the practice - by phone, voicemail, and messaging. The ideal candidate brings healthcare call center experience, a clear and empathetic communication style, and the ability to work accurately across multiple systems in a fast-moving environment.
Training will be provided on all systems. The practice is looking for someone who can be ready to contribute by November 1, 2026.
Key Responsibilities

• Answer inbound calls promptly across patient queues and route callers to the appropriate team when needed

• Schedule, reschedule, and confirm new and returning patient appointments for both in-office and telehealth visits

• Verify and update patient demographic and insurance information accurately at each point of contact

• Return voicemails and respond to patient messages via the practice messaging platform within the same business day

• Warm-transfer billing and insurance inquiries to the appropriate internal team

• Maintain a professional, patient, and empathetic manner across all patient interactions regardless of call volume or complexity
Systems
The practice uses Athena (EHR and scheduling), Klara (patient messaging), and Phreesia (patient intake). Prior experience with any of these platforms is a plus; full training will be provided.
Qualifications
Required

• Minimum 1 year of call center experience, preferably within a medical practice or healthcare setting

• Working knowledge of US health insurance, including commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and TRICARE

• Clear, professional, and empathetic phone manner - patients may be anxious, in pain, or frustrated, and composure matters

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately capture and update patient information while managing an active call

• Comfortable working simultaneously across multiple platforms and systems

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, dedicated home workspace suitable for patient calls
Preferred

• Experience with Athena, Klara, or Phreesia

• Prior experience scheduling telehealth appointments in addition to in-office visits

• Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and patient privacy standards in a remote work context
Schedule and Start Date

• Full-time: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time

• Fully remote

• Target start date: November 1, 2026
What We Are Looking For
Patients calling a medical practice are not calling because everything is going well. The Medical Patient Representative is often the first voice a patient hears, and the tone of that interaction sets the tone for their entire experience with the practice. The right candidate understands this and approaches every call with care, accuracy, and professionalism - whether it is a routine appointment confirmation or a frustrated patient with an unresolved concern.
You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable. You follow through on messages the same day, you document what you do, and you make sure patients leave the interaction feeling heard and taken care of. Healthcare experience is important here - not just because of the systems, but because of the stakes.
Requirements
This is a full time role
Up to $6/hr

title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

As a platform company powering businesses around the world, Stripe processes payments, runs marketplaces, detects fraud, helps entrepreneurs start internet businesses from anywhere, builds world-class, developer-friendly APIs, and more. Stripe’s engineering teams build the business logic that powers all of this. As a software engineering manager at Stripe, you’ll lead teams that build and expand APIs, services, and experiences. You’ll also work with partners to launch new markets and vertical capabilities.

Stripe Terminal helps our users extend their online presence into the physical world. With Terminal, businesses can unify their in-person and online experiences, unlocking payment use cases that fit their business models-whether they’re creating a modern retail experience, extending a website to a pop-up store, or enabling mobile point-of-sale payments at an event.

title: Senior AI Developer - Product Operations
description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role
At Workleap , our engineering teams already ships more than twice as fast with AI. Now we’re expanding beyond code to everything around it: briefs, specs, design, launch, and measurement. The idea is simple: agents do the work, and people make the calls. We’ve are rethinking how we build products and are exploring the technical possibilities, this is just the beginning. As a Senior AI Developer, you’ll join us to shape and build this solution ensuring that we have solid technical foundation.
Your impact:

•
Ship the first production agents with our Product Managers, starting with brief creation and the ProductManager-to-design handoff, then extend to the rest of the product lifecycle.

•
Shape the shared architecture and standards (orchestration, skills, memory, evals, guardrails) so that both our product lines are built on the same foundation.

•
Own the production quality of these agents: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start, with human approval at every gate.

•
Co-design with Product Managers: understand how they work, reuse what they’ve already automated, and ship small iterations they test and adopt.

•
Measure what works: time saved, time from customer signal to shipped decision, and cost per agent and per feature, then cut what doesn’t add value.

•
Grow others: share your agent development practices so the team can build, run, and improve agents on their own.

Your team
Over the next 6 to 12 months, you’ll work on questions like: how does an agent turn an idea into a brief that a Product Manager approves without rewriting it? How do specialized agents pass context without losing it or blowing up costs? How do we decide an agent is reliable enough to lighten a gate? description:

Staff Software Engineer - Metadata

COMPANY PITCH

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud. Thousands of organizations run their most critical data, analytics, and AI workloads on our platform. We built Snowflake for the cloud from day one: near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Our goal is to make every organization's data instantly useful and always available.

TEAM PITCH

The Metadata team owns the brain of Snowflake. Every query, table, transaction, and permission depends on the metadata layer we build. Our systems handle millions of metadata operations per second. We also power cross-region and cross-cloud replication and failover, keeping customer data available through outages. If you want hard distributed-systems problems with direct customer impact, this is the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead the design of core metadata and replication systems across multiple teams.

- Set technical direction for scalability, consistency, and fault tolerance of the metadata layer.

- Drive cross-region and cross-cloud replication toward lower RPO and higher reliability.

- Solve hard problems in performance, availability, and correctness at global scale.

- Partner with Product and architects to turn customer needs into durable designs.

- Raise the operational bar through observability, safe rollouts, and blast-radius controls.

- Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders on the team.

REQUIREMENTS

Core Requirements:

- 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems or database internals.

- Strong development skills in Java or C++.

- Proven record leading multi-team technical initiatives from design to production.

- Deep understanding of consistency, transactions, and fault tolerance.

- BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:

- Experience with FoundationDB or other distributed key-value stores.

- Experience building replication, disaster recovery, or geo-distributed systems.

- Experience with database metadata, catalogs, or query compilation.

- Experience running services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with our customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We embed with users to solve high-leverage problems, move fast from prototype to deployment, and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of field delivery and internal development, working closely with Product, Research, and Go-To-Market (GTM).

About the role
As a foundational FDE manager, you’ll lead FDE through high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own technical and business value outcomes end to end. You’ll grow a team that can operate under pressure and help OpenAI learn from the field.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Sales, and GTM to ensure fieldwork informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale. Your decisions will influence how OpenAI is trusted by the customers closest to our deployment work. Your success will be measured by how consistently your team ships, how clearly you deliver signal to Research and Product, and how durable your team and delivery model prove to be.

In this role you will

- Lead and grow a team of FDE delivering production systems with frontier models

- Own end-to-end delivery outcomes through clarity, speed, tight coordination, and technical quality

- Codify what works into tools, playbooks, and roadmap inputs that create leverage for both OpenAI and our wider developer community

- Notice early indicators and raise them with urgency, whether in product behavior, customer environments, or delivery practices

- Use judgement to distinguish what requires action and what does not

- Set a high bar for FDE performance and support each person’s growth through direct, actionable feedback

- Define how we staff and support field teams that can scale without added complexity

You might thrive in this role if you

- Bring 8+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing FDE or customer-facing engineers

- Have led high-pressure technical projects from prototype to production

- Simplify complex work and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

- Elevate team performance through clarity, not process

- Operate with urgency in ambiguous or evolving environments

- Translate field experience into sharp, actionable feedback for Product and Research

- Build deep trust with your team by modeling calm, focus, and judgment when it matters most

title: RTL Design Engineer, Networking / NoC
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for an RTL Design Engineer to help design and develop next-generation AI accelerator silicon. In this role, you'll work across architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation, translating complex system and performance requirements into efficient, scalable hardware designs.

You'll collaborate closely with silicon architects, hardware and software engineers, verification, and physical design teams to co-design hardware solutions optimized for demanding AI workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role with opportunities to influence architectural decisions, drive microarchitecture development, and own RTL design from early concept through implementation and integration.

We're particularly interested in engineers with experience in Network-on-Chip (NoC), networking, interconnect architectures, or high-performance data movement, though the role encompasses broader RTL design and hardware co-design challenges.

In this role, you will:

- Design and implement high-performance RTL for next-generation AI accelerator silicon, from microarchitecture definition through implementation and integration.

- Collaborate with architecture and software teams to translate system-level requirements into efficient hardware microarchitectures.

- Drive hardware/software co-design efforts to optimize performance, power, area, and scalability for AI workloads.

- Develop and optimize RTL for complex datapaths, control logic, interconnects, and other critical silicon subsystems.

- Evaluate architectural and microarchitectural tradeoffs across bandwidth, latency, throughput, and resource utilization.

- Partner with design verification and formal verification teams to ensure functional correctness, develop verification strategies, and debug complex design issues.

- Work closely with physical design teams to optimize RTL for synthesis, timing closure, power, and area.

- Contribute to architecture reviews, design specifications, and cross-functional discussions to influence future silicon designs.

- Support block-level and SoC-level integration, debugging, and performance optimization.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have strong hands-on experience with ASIC RTL design and microarchitecture development using SystemVerilog or Verilog.

- Have experience designing and implementing complex digital hardware blocks, from architecture and specification through RTL development and verification.

- Understand hardware architecture and microarchitecture tradeoffs, including performance, power, area, latency, and throughput.

- Have experience collaborating across architecture, software, verification, and physical design teams to develop optimized hardware solutions.

- Can reason about complex hardware systems, identify performance bottlenecks, and translate architectural requirements into efficient RTL implementations.

- Have experience with synthesis, timing closure, and physical implementation considerations.

- Enjoy working on ambiguous, technically challenging problems and taking ownership of designs from concept through integration.

- Bring experience with Network-on-Chip (NoC), networking, interconnect fabrics, packet-based architectures, or high-bandwidth data movement systems.

- Experience with AI accelerators, high-performance computing, or hardware/software co-design is a plus.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

• Communicate complaint trends, systemic issues, and relevant regulatory developments to senior stakeholders in a clear and actionable way.

• Understanding of regulated complaint handling, including fair outcomes, evidence-based decisions, and documentation standards.

Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.
To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,

title: Senior Network Engineer - DDoS - Remote
description:
Do you have a passion for network engineering technologies?
Are you looking for the freedom to innovate and help shape the next generation of the network?
Join our Network Engineering team!
The Network Engineering team designs, automates, and supports the global network powering Akamai's products and services. Using advanced technologies, the team ensures optimal connectivity and performance for customers and the compute platform.
Partner with the best
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will lead efforts in designing, implementing, and automating Akamai's global network infrastructure. You will address complex issues in routing, data center fabrics, DDoS defense, and automation to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. This role involves driving the evolution of network infrastructure, from initial architecture through to implementation.
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for:

• Designing, building, and maintaining our global network infrastructure.

• Designing and implementing automated detection and mitigation strategies for inbound and outbound DDoS attacks.

• Developing and maintaining Akamai's core network configuration templates using Jinja2.

• Implementing new hardware platforms and network features within the automation framework.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define data models and functional requirements.

• Serving as a subject matter expert for complex network issues, performing deep-dive troubleshooting and analysis.

• Creating and maintaining clear documentation & procedures.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 8 years relevant experience and a High school /Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or its equivalent experience

• Demonstrate extensive experience in IP network design and implementation of scalable BGP routing architecture.

• Be able to understand Data Center architecture, including CLOS Fabric and overlay technologies such as VxLAN and EVPN.

• Have experience in managing and troubleshooting multi-vendor environments like Juniper, Cisco & routing platforms like BIRD, FRR and Cumulus.

• Possess solid experience with DDoS detection and mitigation platforms to safeguard inbound and outbound traffic.

• Have the ability to understand end-to-end data flows and traffic patterns.

• Have experience developing and managing network configuration templates utilizing automation tools like Python, Ansible, and Jinja2 effectively and efficiently.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

- Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences

- Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Professional proficiency in French or German

The Senior Cybersecurity Culture Specialist is responsible for helping strengthen cybersecurity culture by translating cyber risk into practical, engaging experiences that influence employee behavior and reinforce secure ways of working. The role will develop and execute global awareness campaigns, role-based learning, phishing and social-engineering resilience activities, and communications that connect cybersecurity expectations to business, customer, and operational outcomes.
This position reports to the Director, Cybersecurity Culture and Awareness and is part of the Cybersecurity organization. The role will be based in Europe and will support a global audience while partnering across functions and operating businesses. The specific European location and work arrangement will be defined in the requisition.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Develop and execute enterprise cybersecurity culture and awareness campaigns, including audience-specific communications, learning experiences, toolkits, leadership materials, newsletters, SharePoint resources, and role-based learning for higher-risk populations and emerging topics.

• Manage the enterprise phishing resilience program, including recurring enterprise-wide and role-based simulations, campaign planning, user communications and education, metrics, results analysis, and continuous improvement.

• Manage and optimize security awareness platforms, phishing simulation tools, and learning management systems, including operations, enterprise integrations, vendor coordination, content, events, and program deliverables.

• Partner with cybersecurity, HR, communications, legal/privacy, IT, and business stakeholders to identify human-risk priorities, integrate secure behaviors into business processes, and align awareness and training with internal requirements and frameworks and regulations such as NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CMMC.

• Use program data, employee feedback, phishing metrics, and human-risk indicators to measure effectiveness, identify trends and opportunities, and recommend improvements that strengthen security behaviors and reduce business risk.

The essential requirements of the job include :

• Multiple years of professional experience spanning cybersecurity awareness or culture, human risk management, phishing simulation, security awareness platforms, learning technologies, instructional design, project management, information technology, organizational change, learning and development, communications, or closely related disciplines, including experience using the Abnormal Security platform.

• Demonstrated experience in technical writing, instructional design, course development, and creating enterprise communications, awareness campaigns, learning content, or behavior-change initiatives for diverse employee audiences.

• Experience using metrics, survey results, phishing or learning data, or other program measures to evaluate effectiveness and guide program improvements.

• Experience working with cybersecurity concepts and translating technical or risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical audiences, together with experience managing cybersecurity culture or awareness programs and implementing security awareness and training

title: Global Clinical Study Manager

• Collaborates with key stakeholders across the organization and provides regular updates on study progress to senior management as required

• Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed

• Collaborates closely with Global Clinical Supplies to forecast study drug and timely delivery of supplies to sites
